newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan interbank rate ends slightly lower.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan interbank rate ends slightly lower.

text.p: Taiwan's interbank rate closed slightly lower on Wednesday as liquidity level in the banking system remained loose in the absence of tightening factors, dealers said.

The overnight interbank rate ended at 5.243 percent against Tuesday's 5.317 close, with 30-day commercial paper at 5.25 percent against 5.20-5.35. Dealers expected the rates to remain at the current low levels in the near future.
The bond market did not see transactions in the afternoon. The 10-year 84/1 bond yield was at 5.9100 against 5.8950 after morning trade. -- Rachel Lee (5080815)
